settings.gg7EExX0OcM_text: "I thought it was just bad breath – until the vet explained what it could lead to. I will never ignore it again 🩵"
settings.ggEKyY0SfQK_text:
Sarah Thompson, 44, Manchester
🐾 Dog mom to Bella, a 7-year-old Cavalier King Charles Spaniel

25 May 2025
settings.ggV7Ed2OWVJ_text:
I love Bella more than anything. She sleeps by my side every night 🩵

But over several months, I noticed her bad breath getting worse. At first, I thought it was just part of getting older.
 

I tried dental chews, toothpaste, and even a special gel – but the smell always came back.
When I tried brushing her teeth, it was a constant struggle. She squirmed, licked away the toothpaste – and I eventually gave up.
 

It wasn’t until I looked closely and saw that her gums were red and swollen that I started to get really worried.
 

The vet said:
“This isn’t just bad breath – it’s inflammation. And it hurts.”
 

I got a lump in my stomach. She could have been in pain for months – and I hadn’t realized it.
I felt like such a bad dog mom... 😔
settings.ggD3IccTFwP_text: "I didn’t know what to do!"
settings.ggSrno-AKE3_text:
As I sat at the vet with Bella on my lap, I felt both worried and guilty.
I hesitantly said:

"We’ve never really managed to brush her teeth… she really doesn’t like it."
 

The vet smiled gently.

"You’re not alone. Most dogs don’t like it. But there are easier ways to prevent problems that I think you should try."
 

She picked up a small jar and pulled out a moist finger wipe.
 

"You just swipe this over the teeth – it only takes a few seconds."
 

She gently ran the wipe along Bella’s teeth.
No struggle. No pulling. Bella sat calmly.

We both looked a bit surprised – I don’t think even Bella expected it to be that easy.


The vet smiled and said:
"And doing this regularly is all it takes."
settings.gg_22YPeAPS_text: “Jag testade direkt när vi kom hem.”
settings.ggvOzRX72Ip_text:
The next day I picked up the wipe myself.

I was a little hesitant – I thought maybe it only worked that well at the vet’s office because Bella was shocked.
 

But it worked just as smoothly at home!

I had her sit in my lap, swiped over her teeth – and we were done in a few seconds.

Bella mostly looked like she was waiting for a treat afterwards… 😅
 

It felt unreal. No struggle. No guilt. Just done.

And when I saw how much dirt had come off on the wipe…
 

That’s when I realized how bad it actually was – and how easily it could have been avoided.

settings.ggmiQpo080o_text: ""Today Bella feels great again! 🩵 And I feel so much better as a dog mom."
settings.gg8SRACmCQa_text:
Now I use FreshWipes 3 times a week in the evenings, it only takes us 1 minute each time – and we both enjoy it more and more!
 

Bella’s breath is now so much fresher. She sits calmly when I clean her teeth, and I think it’s because she feels my finger and feels safe 🩵
 

I truly feel like a better dog mom now – and Bella feels great!

There’s only one thing I regret…
That I didn’t start earlier!
